market.question: Will the highest temperature in Tokyo be 22°C on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: JMA forecast issued April 26 projects 24°C high for Tokyo on April 28 under partly sunny skies. Question asks if daily high lands in 22°C bucket - 2°C below forecast. With ~1-2°C forecast error 1 day out, 22°C is in the tail. Most probable buckets are 23-25°C.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast revision; cloud cover variability could lower or raise actual high.
